title: [precompile] AOT Precompile serialization failed when running mutliple times
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Create a simple python script `precompile_repro.py`

```python

import torch

class M(torch.nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.linear1 = torch.nn.Linear(2, 4)
        self.relu = torch.nn.ReLU()
        self.linear2 = torch.nn.Linear(4, 8)
    def forward(self, x):
        return self.linear2(self.relu(self.linear1(x)))

device = "cuda"
m = M().to(device)
sample_inputs = (torch.randn(2, 2, device=device),)
eager_out = m(*sample_inputs)

with torch._dynamo.config.patch("enable_aot_compile", True):
    compiled_fn_path = "./m.pt"
    compiled_fn = torch.compile(
        m,
        fullgraph=True
    ).forward.aot_compile((sample_inputs, {}))

    compiled_fn.save_compiled_function(compiled_fn_path)
    torch._dynamo.reset()
    with torch.compiler.set_stance("fail_on_recompile"):
        with open(compiled_fn_path, "rb") as f:
            loaded_fn = torch.compiler.load_compiled_function(f)

assert loaded_fn is not None

compiled_out = loaded_fn(m, *sample_inputs).

assert torch.allclose(eager_out, compiled_out)
```

Then in terminal run `python precompile_repro.py`. It works the first time. Then if running this script again, we will get

```
 File "/data/users/yimingzhou/pytorch/torch/_dynamo/aot_compile.py", line 118, in save_compiled_function
    f.write(type(self).serialize(self))
            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/data/users/yimingzhou/pytorch/torch/_dynamo/aot_compile.py", line 130, in serialize
    type(compiled_fn).serialize_compile_artifacts(compiled_fn),
    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/data/users/yimingzhou/pytorch/torch/_dynamo/aot_compile.py", line 181, in serialize_compile_artifacts
    result = pickle.dumps(fn.compiled_fn.serialize())
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
AttributeError: Can't get local object 'align_inputs_from_check_idxs.<locals>.run'
```

If the device is `cpu`, then running the script the second will get the following error
```
  File "/data/users/yimingzhou/pytorch/precompile-repro.py", line 25, in <module>
    compiled_fn.save_compiled_function(compiled_fn_path)
  File "/data/users/yimingzhou/pytorch/torch/_dynamo/aot_compile.py", line 118, in save_compiled_function
    f.write(type(self).serialize(self))
            ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/data/users/yimingzhou/pytorch/torch/_dynamo/aot_compile.py", line 130, in serialize
    type(compiled_fn).serialize_compile_artifacts(compiled_fn),
    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/data/users/yimingzhou/pytorch/torch/_dynamo/aot_compile.py", line 181, in serialize_compile_artifacts
    result = pickle.dumps(fn.compiled_fn.serialize())
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
AttributeError: Can't get local object 'WeakValueDictionary.__init__.<locals>.remove'
```

The error is gone when adding `fresh_cache()` context manager  from `torch._inductor.utils` 

```python
with fresh_cache(), torch._dynamo.config.patch("enable_aot_compile", True):
     ....aot_compile...
```
Then we can the script multiple times and it always works on both cpu and cuda.
